description: Pinealon is the tripeptide Glu-Asp-Arg, one of the short peptide bioregulators studied in the Russian peptide-research literature. Published work on this peptide family examines effects on gene-expression and cell-culture viability endpoints in neural and other tissue-derived cell models, making it a reference compound for short-peptide bioregulator research rather than a classical receptor-ligand peptide.

faq.question: What is Pinealon?
faq.answer: Pinealon is the tripeptide Glu-Asp-Arg (CAS 175175-23-2) used in short-peptide bioregulator research.

faq.question: What is a peptide bioregulator?
faq.answer: A short peptide (typically 2–4 residues) studied in a specific research tradition for effects on gene expression in cell models, rather than as a classical high-affinity receptor ligand.
